abstract: A 41-year old woman post thyroidectomy and neck dissection is presented in this case. She initially presented goiter and an enlarged cervical lymph node. She had no family history of cancer or radiation therapy. She had total thyroidectomy and found to have papillary thyroid cancer (T4N1M0). Histopathology report revealed multifocal classical papillary thyroid carcinoma with lympho-vascular invasion, extra-thyroidal extension, and positive lymph nodes. She was treated with 6.5 Gigabecquerel (GBq) of 131Iodine. Whole-body scan showed uptake in the neck and large focus in the left lower abdomen. Single-photon emission computed tomography SPECT/CT demonstrated a round shaped mass in the left pelvis. Pathology revealed cystic teratoma with benign thyroid tissue (struma ovarii), and no malignancy. Two months later, she had the second treatment with 5.5 GBq 131Iodine. Her follow-up stimulated and non-stimulated thyroglobulin levels were significantly lower, and there was no abnormal uptake in the follow-up scan.
abstract_ja: 41歳女性。甲状腺全摘術と頸部郭清を受けた。当初は甲状腺腫と頸部リンパ節腫大を呈した。家族歴にがんはなく、放射線治療の既往もなかった。全摘後の病理組織学的所見は、リンパ管・血管侵襲、甲状腺外進展、リンパ節転移陽性を伴う多巣性の古典的乳頭状甲状腺癌（T4N1M0）であった。6.5GBqの131ヨウ素で治療した。全身シンチグラフィで頸部と左下腹部に強い集積を認めた。SPECT/CTで左骨盤内に円形の腫瘤が描出された。病理組織学的に、良性甲状腺組織を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫（卵巣甲状腺腫）で、悪性所見はなかった。2か月後に5.5GBqの131ヨウ素で2回目の治療を行った。その後のフォローアップでの刺激後および非刺激のサイログロブリン値は有意に低下し、フォローアップスキャンに異常集積は認められなかった。
